cue: Ip fixed opening .35*DTmax and maximal-thickness connected component; original masks unchanged; head proxy not truth. Other classes original Polyp mask. P contour>3px from Ring; Q contact directions weight.35, not treated as measured anatomical contour.

observations.HERO_area_quadrature: original incident face area/3, deterministic cumulative-area sampling; equal per-view mass and upstream RGB correlation normalization
observations.robust: soft_l1, f_scale1, each modality normalized sqrt(row count), view/correlation weights fixed before fits
observations.missing: No fake first depths. Undefined relative-depth pair residual is censored, source-ray convex-support feasibility penalized in C; fixed-denominator miss counts and .25mm censored-score reported. Coverage loss/low hit gate prevents PASS; no discrete hit count used as differentiable loss.

optimization.method: scipy least_squares trf, float64, 3-point central numerical derivative
optimization.select: minimum A training objective only, no B values or visual choice; all starts retained
optimization.mesh_points: 24 longitude x13 latitude for optimizer; export96x49
optimization.initialization: A1-0/2/3 only A 2D centroid-ray triangulation, source camera frame, apparent widths and fixed class priors; A1-1 only qualified/conditional HERO point statistics; no B initialization. Star/cap/height common core initialization with A1-2.

stability.uncertainty: range across all starts and fixed perturbation fits, not calibrated CI
fixed_perturbations: first fit camera right-body tx+.05mm and ry+.1deg

gates.nondegenerate: finite, positive, no spikes/nonmanifold/self-crossing certificate; budget exhaustion not automatically converged
gates.G1: at least one qualified real case with frozen independent holdout and nondegenerate result; conditional upstream/selection/Gate dependencies cannot certify strict G1

A_B: B not fit to parameters, but all existing B were used by upstream cameras, HERO/selection or Gate; label CONDITIONAL, not full-pipeline blind test
synthetic: Separate generated truth only; ellipsoid/cap/wide compact mound/head-stalk counterexamples; no synthetic score tunes real parameters. Models frozen before synthetic tests.
background: catalog existing data and Phase-D plane usability only; no fitting, attachment residual, gap measurement or new plane inference this round
